- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_promote_cycle.py: lines 297-299 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: Only one blank line between test_bot_commit_touching_shipped_claude_command_counts_as_untested (ending at line 297) and test_legacy_label_without_marker_keeps_release_callback (starting at line 299).
  WHY: The PR description claims "ruff clean on the changed tests", but running ruff check --select E,F on this file would flag E302 ("expected 2 blank lines, found 1"). The CI ruff step only checks scripts/*.py (ci.yml:308, mark-stable.yml:220, test-and-mark-stable.yml:4078) and does not lint tests, so CI will not trip — but the claim in the PR description is inaccurate, and the formatting invariant of the module is broken for any developer who runs ruff locally or a future test-lint step.
- Requirement: "`test-and-mark-stable.yml` (`validate-scripts`, which the release job needs) and `mark-stable.yml` now run the same suites [that `ci.yml` runs on PRs]" before tagging; PR description specifies "the 18 pytest files from the `ci.yml` Claude steps plus `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py`"; changelog fragment row reads "19 (18 pytest files plus `tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py`)".
  Expected change site: The "Claude asset tests (CLAUDE.md, .claude hooks, scripts, commands)" step in `.github/workflows/mark-stable.yml` (lines 427-453) and `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml` (lines 4282-4308).
  Evidence of absence: The new pytest invocation in both workflows lists 18 files. `ci.yml`'s Claude-asset neighborhood (steps at lines 457-534) actually runs 20 pytest files. The two omitted files directly test the shipped `workflow-templates/.claude/` assets that this PR exists to protect:
  - `tests/test_audit_plans_command.py` (ci.yml:529, step "/audit-plans command contract tests") defines `TEMPLATE_COMMAND = ROOT / "workflow-templates" / ".claude" / "commands" / "audit-plans.md"` (line 14) and `test_template_parity()` (lines 29-30) asserts `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/audit-plans.md` is byte-identical to `.claude/commands/audit-plans.md`. A template-parity regression in the shipped `/audit-plans` command will not fail either release gate.
  - `tests/test_ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` (ci.yml:534, step "Implement-plan lessons ingestion + conformance-stage contract tests") defines `COMMAND_COPIES = (.claude/commands, workflow-templates/.claude/commands)` (lines 272-275) and `test_implement_plan_claude_copies_are_identical()` (lines 278-280) asserts `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md` equals `.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md`. A template-parity regression in that shipped command will not fail either release gate.
  Neither file is in the new step's pytest invocation in either workflow. The PR description's stated goal — "a regression in those files fails the release instead of shipping" — is partially met only: `audit-plans.md` parity is uncovered entirely at release time, and `implement-plan-claude.md` parity loses its `test_ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` conformance coverage (`test_implement_plan_claude_command.py:12,31` does run, but it is a narrower assertion).
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
